name: shadows-of-judgment
description: Simultaneous card battle game with energy management and priority-based combat. Predict your opponent's move and counter it in this strategic 1v1 duel!

scripts.deploy: gcloud run deploy shadows-of-judgment --project shadowsofjudgement --source . --region europe-west1 --allow-unauthenticated --session-affinity --min-instances 0 --max-instances 1 --memory 256Mi --cpu 1 --port 8080
scripts.deploy:logs: gcloud run services logs read shadows-of-judgment --project shadowsofjudgement --region europe-west1 --limit 50
